methods.name: answer
methods.signature: answer(self, question: str, *, top_k: int = 4, history: Sequence[ConversationTurn] | None = None, filters: MetadataFilters | None = None) -> AgentAnswer
methods.summary: Answer a user question using retrieved feedback as evidence.
methods.description:
Two deterministic guardrail gates protect the run: the input gate
refuses unsafe questions before retrieval, and the context gate drops
retrieved chunks carrying injection-style content before generation.

When ``history`` (previous conversation turns) is supplied, follow-up
questions are first rewritten into standalone questions using the last
turn, and the rewritten question drives routing, retrieval, and
generation. The full history is never sent to retrieval. Without
``history`` the single-turn behaviour is unchanged.

methods.name: chat
methods.signature: chat(self, message: str, *, store: ConversationStore, conversation_id: str | None = None, top_k: int = 4, filters: MetadataFilters | None = None) -> tuple[AgentAnswer, str]
methods.summary: Answer a message inside a stored conversation and persist the turn.
methods.description:
Loads the conversation from ``store`` (or starts a new one when
``conversation_id`` is ``None``), answers with the previous turns as
context, records the new turn (user message, answer, cited document
IDs, route, and confidence), and saves the conversation back.

returns.description:
The agent answer and the conversation identifier (newly generated
    when none was supplied).

classes.name: DeterministicQueryRewriter
classes.summary: Local, deterministic follow-up rewriter with two transparent rules.
classes.description:
1. **Pronoun resolution**: standalone pronouns (``it``, ``they``, ``them``,
   trailing ``this``/``that``/...) are replaced with the salient entities
   of the previous user message.
2. **Ellipsis expansion**: elliptical openers ("What about X?", "And X?")
   and very short questions get the previous turn's missing entities
   appended ("... regarding enterprise onboarding").

Standalone questions are returned unchanged, so single-turn behaviour is
never affected. No model call is involved.

methods.summary: Register a template and return it, rejecting duplicate name/version pairs.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(self, name: str, version: str = LATEST_VERSION) -> PromptTemplate
methods.summary: Return a template by name and version (or the latest registered version).

methods.name: names
methods.summary: Return all registered prompt names, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: versions
methods.summary: Return the registered versions for a prompt in registration order.

methods.name: list_templates
methods.signature: list_templates(self, name: str | None = None) -> tuple[PromptTemplate, ...]
methods.summary: Return registered templates, optionally filtered by prompt name.

methods.name: render
methods.signature: render(self, name: str, version: str = LATEST_VERSION, **variables: str) -> str
methods.summary: Resolve a template and render it with the given variables.

constructor.name: __init__
constructor.summary: Create an empty registry.

classes.name: PromptTemplate
classes.summary: A named, versioned prompt template with declared variables.
classes.description:
``required_variables`` must be provided on every render. ``optional_variables``
map variable names to default values used when the caller omits them. The
union of both must exactly match the placeholders found in ``template``.

methods.name: render
methods.summary: Render the template, raising a clear error on missing or unknown variables.

classes.name: PromptVariableError
classes.summary: Raised when render variables do not match a template's declared variables.

classes.name: QdrantStoreError
classes.summary: Raised when the Qdrant store cannot be configured or reached.

classes.name: QdrantVectorStore
classes.summary: Cosine-similarity vector store backed by a Qdrant collection.
classes.description:
The collection is created on demand using ``Distance.COSINE`` so the scoring
orientation matches the in-memory store: higher scores mean more similar.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: add(self, chunks: list[DocumentChunk], vectors: npt.NDArray[np.float64]) -> None
methods.summary: Upsert chunks and their vectors into the collection.

methods.name: search
methods.signature: search(self, query_vector: npt.NDArray[np.float64], *, top_k: int = 4) -> list[SearchResult]
methods.summary: Return the most similar chunks for a query vector (highest score first).

properties.name: size
properties.summary: Number of indexed chunks in the collection.

properties.name: chunks
properties.summary: Return all indexed chunks, reconstructed from point payloads.

constructor.name: __init__
constructor.signature: __init__(self, dim: int, *, url: str = 'http://localhost:6333', collection_name: str = 'feedback_intelligence', client: QdrantClient | None = None) -> None
